v11-66.candidate: They asked him for his right hand in pledge, and he gave it to them. He expelled them from there, seized the city, and placed a garrison over it.
v11-66.close: They asked him to receive a pledge of peace, and he gave it to them. He expelled them from there, seized the city, and placed a garrison over it.

v11-68.candidate: Behold! The army of foreigners met him in the plain, having sent out an ambush against him in the mountains, while they themselves met him from the front.
v11-68.close: The army of foreigners met him in the plain, having sent out an ambush against him in the mountains, while they themselves met him from the front.
